dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: My workload is higher than I can manage this week.
dialogue.zh: 这周的工作量超过了我能处理的程度。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: How much capacity do you have for the new task?
dialogue.zh: 你还有多少精力可以处理新任务？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Very little. I listed the deadlines in this notebook. Could we delegate one item?
dialogue.zh: 很少。我把截止日期列在这个笔记本里了。我们能把其中一项交给别人吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Let us review the priorities and move one task to another teammate.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我们看看优先级，把一项任务交给另一位同事。

communication_goal: 说明可用精力并协商任务分配。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers calmly discussing workload at a small desk. A large OPEN PAPER NOTEBOOK is laid flat on the front-right of the desk, two facing pages, visible center fold, short abstract ruling only with no writing, not a laptop. Left developer sits with slightly worried face and open palm; right team lead sits and gestures toward notebook without covering it. Notebook fully visible, separated from hands.

coverage_review.scope: W075 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W075.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：纯黑背景白色火柴人线稿，单幅双人工作沟通场景、底图无文字；桌面展开的纸质笔记本可定位，不与电脑混淆。 其余3词仅以明确对白支持，不虚构局部框。 局部裁剪复查后扩大右/下边界，保护完整道具。
